sourceScope: 1952 economic coordination treaty and constitutional promulgation chronology

evidence.claim: 1952-05-24 economic agreement signed by Paek and Meyer, not Rhee
Paek says cabinet approved amended draft; no direct Rhee instruction shown
1952-07-07 Rhee promulgated amendment with Chang countersignature; Article32 direct election of both chambers
1952-07-08 Rhee directed presidential-centered operation of revised constitution
1952-05-23 Rhee told Muccio he authorized Paek to sign economic agreement and demanded dollar settlement backing currency reform
1952-05-27 Rhee told Van Fleet cabinet decided martial law, he approved and suggested Pusan inclusion, and Won would take orders directly from him
US policy staff considered delaying economic payments and forming board but warned of treaty breach

contradictions.description: National Archives curator dates 55th cabinet 7/4 09:30 while vote was 7/4 night; originals needed
NAA curator appears to carry May draft one-third appointed senators into July promulgation analysis, despite Article32 direct election

guardrail: US diplomats' records of Rhee's statements are strong evidence of what he said, not equivalent to original ROK authorization/appointment instruments or proof of actual implementation.

correctionHistory.note: Late direct reading FRUS d135 narrows prior 'no Rhee direct authorization' to 'Rhee reported approving Paek signature, no Korean written order'.
FRUS d144 provides Rhee self-reported martial-law approval and Won direct command; still no original ROK order.
